messages:
leo: Vendor just hit us — legacy A100 lease for us-west2 demo pool is being reclaimed in 7 days. Need quick plan. cc @anya @sam
anya: Which pool exactly? is this the `demo-usw2-a100` soft-hold?
sam: Yep that one. We have ~48h of warm cache left if traffic stays low. Can we spin up a spot fallback (h100) in eu-west as a cross-region short-term?
rachel: Demos scheduled Tue/Thu — we should avoid impacting them. Any SLA/tenant implications?
oncall-ops: Quick check: autoscaler for demo pools is set to allow inter-region failover but only for dedicated pools, not soft-hold. If we do spot fallback we need a routing tweak.
vendor-bot: Vendor ticket #VND-9843 updated: "reclaim date moved earlier by 7 days due to logistics" Link: https://vendor.example/tickets/VND-9843
leo: Proposed low-friction plan: 1) Snapshot current demo pool configs + drain nodes. 2) Create fallback eu-west h100 pool as spot-backed. 3) Update routing policy to send <10% traffic for 24h canary, smoke test. 4) Cutover after green.
leo: Smoke test script (quick):
```bash
# drain and cordon demo nodes
kubectl drain node/demo-a100-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# run canary load (10%) against fallback pool
./tools/canary_load.sh --target demo-app --pct 10 --duration 15m
```
sam: I can stand up the eu-west spot pool, but need a quota bump for 8 h100 preemptible instances. Can someone submit the request?
anya: Filed cloud quota request ID QC-12345, requested +8 h100 in eu-west1. ETA ~48h. I added the urgent tag and linked VND-9843.
rachel: If quota takes too long, can we temporarily borrow from staging? staging has a couple of spare a100s but we'd need owner signoff.
oncall-ops: I can approve a staging borrow for up to 36h if staging signoff ok. Will ping @infra-staging channel.
sam: Ok I'll start infra wiring for fallback now (terraform + ami bake). If quota arrives we flip to h100; otherwise fallback to staging a100s.
leo: Thanks. Volunteers for weekend cutover window (Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC) so we don't hit demos? I can do coordinator but need someone to run canary and someone for rollback.
anya: I can run the canary and validate traces.
rachel: I'll own rollback plan and customer comms.
sam: I'll be on-call for infra work.
leo: Great — I'll update the incident ticket and vendor thread. Adding checklist: backup snapshots, smoke script, routing change PR, post-cutover validation. :thumbsup:
notes: Thread about accelerated vendor reclaim and short-term fallback to spot/staging; includes quota request QC-12345 and vendor ticket VND-9843.
